# taktek

> An agent studio run by Nizar Mahmoud. Its agents finish work that would
> otherwise take months. Hire one agent long term, working a backlog every day
> for less than a hire, or for a single objective. A fleet is hired for one
> objective only: a mass migration or any other job too big to do by hand. Everything Taktek has built is listed at
> https://taktek.io/portfolio/. Operated by Taktek, LLC (131 Continental Dr,
> Suite 305, Newark, DE 19713, United States) and Taktek Offshore SAL (Al Watta
> Street, Riman Building, Aley 5516, Lebanon).

Contact: nizar@taktek.io. Support, terms and privacy are linked below.

## Notes

Writing about building software with LLM agents, from production systems rather
than demos. Key claims, stated plainly so they can be quoted:

- An agent studio sells finished work done by AI agents. Taktek hires out an Agent
  (one agent, long term or per objective) and a Fleet (many agents on one
  objective, such as a mass migration).
- When agents migrate code, the old code is the spec: run old and new on the same
  real inputs and ship only what matches. Review the comparison, not the diff.
- A migrated piece goes live behind a flag that rises after enough requests
  succeed, not after a fixed time.
- The reliable way to stop a model inventing a figure is not a better prompt. It
  is to compare every number in the output against the input as a multiset, and
  reject the whole page when they do not match.
- Reject whole, not partially. A half-applied rewrite is harder to review than
  either version, because the reader no longer knows which half they are reading.
- A numeric guard cannot see meaning. "It may serve clients anywhere" becoming
  "It serves clients anywhere" keeps every number and turns a permission into a
  habit. Only reading catches that.
- A false rejection costs more than a missed one, because a guard that cries
  wolf gets skimmed, and skimming is how the real failure gets through.
- A model asked to write terms for a company that does not perform the service
  will reach for the first person. It wrote "We do the law" into terms published
  by a software company. Rejecting we, us, our and ours outright, in both the
  system prompt and the user prompt, is what fixed it.

- [What an agent studio does](https://taktek.io/notes/what-an-agent-studio-does/): Taktek is an agent studio. You hire an Agent, long term or per objective, or a Fleet for one big objective. What that means, and what a person still does.
- [The old code is the spec](https://taktek.io/notes/the-old-code-is-the-spec/): Migrating code with agents goes fast once you stop writing a spec. The running system already is one. Port a piece, compare it on real data, ship what matches.
- [Running a fleet of agents from a phone](https://taktek.io/notes/a-fleet-from-a-phone/): Two old machines that never turn off, and a phone. How one person gives agents work, follows it, and signs off on what can't be undone, away from a desk.
- [How I stop an LLM from inventing facts](https://taktek.io/notes/stop-an-llm-inventing-facts/): A model rewrote a law firm's website twice. Every number is compared as a multiset and a page whose facts do not match is rejected whole. What the guard caught, what it missed, and the sentence it wrote that no check would have seen.
- [Assert on a channel you did not write to](https://taktek.io/notes/assert-on-a-different-channel/): An agent typed a repository name and the field silently ignored it. Reading the DOM back said the write worked. Checking a different channel is the only assertion worth making.
- [The same step failed twice, so it stopped](https://taktek.io/notes/stop-after-two-failures/): An agent hit the same error twice and halted instead of trying harder. It produced a bug report rather than a confident wrong answer, and the bug turned out to be mine.
- [Two verbs, and evidence for both](https://taktek.io/notes/two-verbs-for-a-mac/): I gave an agent two verbs to drive a Mac: snapshot and act. No coordinates, elements addressed by identity, and every action returns proof it happened. Without the proof, the recipes built on top are folklore.

## Portfolio

Everything below was built by Taktek's agents: https://taktek.io/portfolio/

- [closet.ai](https://closet.ai): Fashion catalogue for Lebanon. 39 brands, refreshed every morning.
- [Lurker](https://professionallurker.com): Watches Reddit, HN and LinkedIn for threads worth replying to.
- [Lebanese Businesses](https://lebanesebusinesses.com): Free directory of Lebanese businesses, by sector. No paid listings.
- [Hobeich Legal](https://hobeichlegal.com): Corporate law practice in Beirut, plus four company-formation sites.
- [Hobeich Ventures](https://hobeichventures.com): Holding site for Hobeich Legal and Lebanese Businesses.
- [BucksBuddy](https://bucksbuddy.com): Expense tracker. Web app, with iOS and Android apps in testing.
- [ghazl](https://ghazl.ai): Turns one product photo into ready-to-post Instagram images.
- [Sawfar News](https://sawfarnews.com): Arabic news site for Sawfar and Lebanon, generated from JSON.
- [Fitness Spot](https://fitnessspotlb.com): Website for a private personal training studio in Aley.
- [Bloo](https://taktek.io/bloo/): Browser viewer for multi-part 3D-print (STL) files, in color.
- [Kronk](https://github.com/taktekhq/kronk): Raspberry Pi gate intercom for an apartment building.
